decisions.reason: A multi-model executive desk line with its own page reflects substantial investment and visible commitment to the announced flexible-workplace direction, so management will attribute any early weakness to market ramp-up.
The chair family sits close to the core offer, is prominently presented and fits the living and office strategy, so a single year of results gives no reason to abandon it.
Floor cushions made from carpets support the sustainability and materials narrative and have a dedicated page, so management will persist despite their niche character.
The sofa is close to the core but only mentioned on the website, which signals weaker public commitment, yet upholstery is central to premium living and it will likely be kept for now.
The high standing table complements the conference and lounge offer with little extra investment and has its own page, so it is likely to stay.

Although the rug collection is distant from the core, its multi-model line, dedicated page and links to the carpet cushions and interior-solutions direction create commitment that management will justify by pointing to early-stage results.
